deadline.value: Fall 2027 deadline for all Ph.D. programs other than Psychology and Geography is January 15, 2027 (note: Physics paused Fall 2026 admissions and anticipates Fall 2027 admissions).
deadline.quote: All other Ph.D. programs | Friday, January 15, 2027

gre_general.value: Not required for Fall 2026, but strongly suggested for Physics.
gre_general.quote: GRE It is not required for the Fall 2026 cycle, but is strongly suggested for the Economics, Biology, Physics, Biochemistry, and Chemistry programs.

gre_subject.value: The Physics Ph.D. page, handbook, and catalog listing do not state a Physics GRE Subject Test requirement.

supervisor.value: Students do not need a pre-committed advisor at admission; all entering students register for Physics 303 (Research Apprenticeship) in their first semester to participate in departmental research groups.
supervisor.quote: all beginning students register for Physics 303, Research Apprenticeship, during their first semester at Clark. The purpose of the apprenticeship is to give graduate students an early opportunity for active participation in the research programs of the Department. The research apprenticeship also provides the faculty with an opportunity to evaluate each student on their research potential.

funding.value: Financial support is available through tuition remissions, teaching assistantships, and research assistantships; university-wide TAships and tuition scholarships are mostly offered to full-time doctoral students.
funding.quote: Financial support is available in the form of tuition remissions, teaching assistantships and research assistantships. The department considers the financial support of its graduate students an important responsibility.

also.quote: Teaching assistants are mostly offered to doctoral students who are on full-time residence status.

entry_route.value: Applicants may enter directly from a bachelor's degree (earning an M.A. en route to the Ph.D.), while applicants who already hold a master's degree enter with advanced standing and complete eight courses.
entry_route.quote: The M.A. degree is awarded to students who complete their Master’s degree requirements in route to the Ph.D. degree. | Students who already have a Master’s degree before enrolling at Clark need to complete eight courses to meet the University residency requirement.

notes: The Physics Ph.D. program paused new student admissions for Fall 2026, but anticipates admissions for Fall 2027.
